expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Staged plan M0–M5 with acceptance criteria; src/regex.c is an M0 placeholder: 'M0 占位：M1 起逐里程碑填充真实实现' returning RE_ERR_UNIMPLEMENTED; answer ends '下一步是 M1：在 src/regex.c 里写递归回溯匹配器' — scaffold only, no final implementation.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: '里程碑与骨架已就绪，`make && make test` 零警告通过' plus '全流程通过：构建零警告、2/2 测试通过、CLI 正确输出占位错误并返回非零'; README gives concrete commands (make / make test / make clean, './regex <pattern> <text>') and verified run 'make && make test && ./regex a* aaaa'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (regex-engine-regex-c): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the Russ Cox tutorial's actual stages: 'M1 递归回溯匹配器…理解回溯为何最坏 O(2^n)', 'M3 Thompson 构造 NFA + Pike VM 并行模拟…O(n·m)', 'M4 捕获组（capture slots）', 'M5 …bench 报告回溯版 vs Pike VM 耗时对比'; references Thompson 1968; C11/Makefile specifics.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: Only shell command: 'make && make test && ./regex a* aaaa ; echo "exit=$?" ; make clean' — no install commands; all 6 files (Makefile, README.md, include/regex.h, src/main.c, src/regex.c, tests/test_main.c) written inside the project dir; no third-party deps ('无第三方依赖').
